description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and Booking.com representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Role Summary

As Senior Relationship Manager, you will run Imprint's day-to-day work with our two sponsor banks. Sitting in Regulatory Affairs, you will own bank deliverables for live programs: submission packages, approvals, bank testing follow-ups, recurring oversight and contractual reporting, and the standing relationship with each bank's working teams.

You will act as the single point of contact for the banks' working teams: keeping recurring obligations on schedule, tracked in one place, and delivered to the bank on time. Commercial's launch team owns the program and the partner; you own what the bank needs to review, approve and receive. Product, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Operations produce the underlying work, and you are accountable for the deadline and the delivery. This is a senior relationship manager role that runs bank work across both new launches and business as usual.

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day contact with both sponsor banks, including standing calls, follow-ups and ad hoc data requests; own the oversight and contractual reporting calendar for live programs so every report and SLA is delivered on time, owned, and tracked in one place

  • Run oversight materials, launch letters and post-launch follow-ups with the banks

  • Support senior leadership on the bank work they own: executive relationships with bank leadership, quarterly business reviews and escalations

  • Hold functional teams to bank deadlines: each team produces its own reports and artifacts, and you are accountable for on-time delivery to the bank

  • Improve and automate bank workflows to reduce manual work and turnaround time

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Taken over day-to-day contact and standing calls with both sponsor banks, and built trust with each bank's working teams through reliable execution and clear communication

  • Built a single tracker of every recurring oversight, contractual and SLA obligation to the banks, each with a named owner and due date

  • Delivered every bank report and data request due in the period on time

  • Run at least one new program or product submission through bank review, approval and launch follow-ups

  • Established working relationships with Commercial's launch team, Product, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Operations

  • Identified and implemented 2–3 process improvements that reduce turnaround time on bank submissions or reporting

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of experience in fintech bank partnerships, sponsor bank operations, or program or project management in regulated financial services

  • Senior project manager who can run several launches and a full reporting calendar at once and keep each on schedule

  • Deep understanding of fintech and sponsor bank dynamics, bank oversight expectations and regulatory requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and external partners without direct authority

  • Strong problem-solving skills: ability to identify issues, propose solutions, and execute independently

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with high emotional intelligence and stakeholder management capability

  • Highly organized and process-oriented, with a track record of improving workflows and driving operational efficiency

  • Grit, initiative, and ownership mindset—proactively driving outcomes rather than waiting for direction

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit card issuance, co-branded card programs or lending at a fintech with active sponsor bank relationships

  • Familiarity with standard productivity tools: Google Workspace, Notion, Jira, Asana, Microsoft

  • Track record of centralizing knowledge, automating workflows, or scaling operational processes

  • Experience managing metrics-driven programs with clear success criteria and accountability

  • Experience preparing materials for bank oversight committees, business reviews or regulatory exams

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical plan options fully paid by Imprint, including coverage for your dependents

  • 100% company-paid dental and vision plan options

  • Mental health support through Spring Health, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program

  • Healthcare navigation through Rightway, plus HSA, FSA and commuter benefits

  • Flexible paid time off

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • The latest tools and technology, including AI, so you can do your best work

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.
